title: Good shoe bench, but I had to fix a few issues, which a customer should never have to...
text:
Good shoe bench, but I had to fix a few issues, which a customer should never have to.... [[VIDEOID:3946c6ab7c270e7d63182d385fd22c1e]] THE GOOD:
--------------
* Nice dimensions. At 43"x13"x18" it's wide enough for two to sit while putting on shoes, and at 13" deep, it won't take a lot of your hallway space.
* Visually, looks good. The fabric seats are more comfortable compared to bare wooden ones.

THE BAD:
------------
* I had a lot of problems with my set. Two of the legs were manufacture defects, or unfinished legs.
* The final product was not level. The bottom of the feet have hard plastic furniture glides. The type that you nail in. To solve my leveling issue, I pried one out and added a few washers then nailed the glider back. Solved my problem. Take a look at my photos to see what I mean.

My personal experience with this product gives it a 3-Star rating. The reason I'm not even more harsh is because the bench works despite the unfinished legs. But overall, this brand didn't give me a good first impression.
